facts.fact: AfriqueITNews reports that Brazzaville delivery and payments start-up Noki Noki closed a $3 million (1.8 billion FCFA) seed round led by Uma Ventures, described as a first in the Republic of Congo.

COG.note: Document states no startup law, strategy or public fund.

facts.fact: AfriqueITNews reports that in May 2024 Noki Noki joined the TotalEnergies incubator in Pointe-Noire, selected from 100 candidates for a two-year incubation programme.
